positive_prompt: Elegant and sophisticated event programme design for an ‘Annual Excellence Awards’ ceremony. The background evokes a luxurious, formal setting with a subtle, textured gold-foil effect reminiscent of embossed paper. A deep black background provides a dramatic contrast to the gold accents. The composition utilizes a central vertical axis, with a sense of depth achieved through layering and subtle gradients. The overall atmosphere is one of prestige and celebration. Lighting is soft and diffused, contributing to a sense of grandeur.
negative_prompt: Low resolution, blurry, distorted, noisy, amateurish, cluttered, plastic-looking, modern, minimalist, overly bright, cartoonish.
short_design_rationale: This design utilizes a classic, sophisticated aesthetic to reflect the premium nature of the event. The dark background and gold accents create a sense of luxury and importance, aligning with the ‘Celebrating Excellence’ theme.
